intake_form.duration_or_onset: Started about six weeks ago as the days got shorter
intake_form.daily_life_impact: I struggle to keep up with the house and often snap at my kids, which leaves me feeling guilty and more exhausted.
intake_form.unhelpful_thought: They should be grateful for the nutritious dinners I prepare and stop nagging me for cookies every single week.
intake_form.support_preference: Needs validation of the effort involved in winter parenting before discussing solutions
intake_form.initial_utterance: It’s just been a really heavy couple of weeks. I spend so much time getting dinner on the table, but all I hear is complaints about dessert.
additional_private_context: I used to run three times a week but have stopped completely because it's too dark and cold.
I keep the kitchen perfectly organized, which makes the mess from their requests feel even more irritating.
My partner travels for work in the winter, so I handle most evening routines alone.

intake_form.personal_background: I live in Dublin with one sister, a niece, and a nephew. I am nearing the end of my degree while managing the care of my elderly parents.
intake_form.presenting_concern: I feel drained and disconnected as the winter days get shorter, struggling to maintain the energy to care for my parents and finish my studies.
intake_form.winter_context: The early sunsets in Dublin make it hard to find time for myself or feel motivated to engage with friends during the dark evenings.
intake_form.duration_or_onset: started a few months ago as the days got shorter
intake_form.daily_life_impact: I spend most evenings sitting in the dark watching TV instead of studying or calling my sister, which makes me feel guilty.
intake_form.unhelpful_thought: After spending the whole day helping my parents, they should at least thank me properly instead of just taking it for granted.
intake_form.support_preference: wants to vent about the daily grind before hearing any advice
intake_form.initial_utterance: It’s getting dark so early here in Dublin, and I’m just so tired of the routine. I feel like I’m doing everything for my parents and getting nothing back.
additional_private_context: I have been skipping my evening study sessions because I feel too exhausted to focus.
My sister lives nearby but we haven't spoken in weeks because I feel resentful that she doesn't help more.
I’ve been eating more cake and less healthy food because it’s the only comfort I have left at night.
